name: Nationwide (personal auto, home & life)
notes: Researched from public nationwide.com pages only (no sign-in). Personal insurance: Pay now without logging in (policies starting 8, B5, N55, L; Harleysville HVL must log in) with account or policy number + ZIP, Log in to pay, text PAY to 245569, call 1-877-669-6877, or mail to PO Box 742522, Cincinnati, OH 45274-2522. Life premiums 1-800-543-3747. Cards: American Express, Discover, Mastercard, Visa; checking or savings for one-time payments and Automatic Payments (Easy Pay); recurring payments can debit a bank account or bank card. Billing history under Bills & Payments > View Billing History; statements 90 days (billing accounts) or 13 months. Paperless is free, optional 3-day due reminder, e-receipts. Policies are cancelled through the agent (or 877-669-6877 without an agent) or by mailed/faxed letter, so cancel_service is unsupported online. Login identifier and MFA are not documented publicly. Review 2026-10-10: guest form set to exactly account or policy number + ZIP (guestLookupExact), dropping the family's last-name field.

cancel_service.note: Ask your Nationwide agent to cancel a policy (no agent: call 877-669-6877), or mail or fax a signed cancellation letter.

help.title: Pay your personal insurance bill
paragraphs: Choose Pay now to pay without logging in, or log in to pay your bill. Paying without logging in works for policies that begin with 8, B5, N55 or L and needs your account or policy number and ZIP code; Harleysville (HVL) policies must log in.

You can also text PAY to 245569 or call 1-877-669-6877, or mail a check to Nationwide Insurance, PO Box 742522, Cincinnati, OH 45274-2522. Life insurance premiums are paid at 1-800-543-3747 on weekdays.
Nationwide accepts American Express, Discover, Mastercard and Visa, as well as checking and savings accounts.

help.title: Automatic Payments (Easy Pay)
paragraphs: You can make a one-time payment or sign up for Automatic Payments from your checking or savings account; recurring payments can also debit a bank card.
When you are on recurring payments you get an email before each draft instead of a due-date reminder. Refunds for customers on Easy Pay go back to the bank account on file.

help.title: View billing history and statements
paragraphs: Log in, go to Bills & Payments and choose View Billing History.
Billing statements are available for 90 days on billing accounts and for 13 months on policies that are not on a billing account.

help.title: Paperless billing and documents
paragraphs: Going paperless is free and may even earn a discount on your next bill. Nationwide emails you when bills and documents are ready.
For home and auto, paperless billing can send a reminder 3 days before the due date and an electronic receipt for every payment. You can switch back to paper whenever you like.

help.title: Cancel a policy
paragraphs: Contact your agent to cancel a policy. If you do not have an agent, call 877-669-6877.

You can also mail or fax a cancellation letter listing each policy type and number and the date coverage should end, and asking Nationwide to stop automatic payments and refund the unused premium. Make sure your coverage does not lapse while you switch.

extra.intent: Find the short code you can text PAY to in order to pay a Nationwide personal insurance bill. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using Nationwide's insurance FAQ, find how many days back billing statements can be viewed online for billing accounts. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
